services.name: Summer Programs
services.desc: Join us for our beloved Summer programming! We offer week-long camps and weekly classes. Also, be sure to check out our summer drop-in schedule! We offer Itsy Bitsy, Half Day, Full Day, and Fuller Day camps! In addition to their time gymnastics training, campers will do tie-dye, games, build forts, and draw with sidewalk chalk. Our Summer programs begin with a warm-up, followed by time on the vault, uneven bars, beam, floor, and trampoline, and end with a cool-down.
